description: Explicit paper-mode helper. Requires a registered local launcher identity plus paper:true, then creates an isolated zero-fund sandbox with a least-privilege paper key. For cold start read felix://getting-started; for real money use create_account.

accept_terms.description: Must be true to confirm acceptance of Felix Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Risk Disclosure.

activate.description: Switch this local MCP session to the derived key without exposing it. Raw key export is disabled.

email.description: Optional new email for the isolated child. Omit to generate a fresh internal child identity.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable retry key for this account creation. Reuse it after a timeout.

label.description: Optional label, max 80 chars. Defaults server-side.

legal_version.description: Current Felix legal bundle version. Omit to use the version bundled with this MCP build.

paper.description: Required explicit simulation selection. Must be true.

name: derive_api_key
